verdict.rationale: Khoj can generate and run Python code, so containment is a fair question, but the evidence never says that code runs in a sandbox, container or VM. The only containment-adjacent controls are per-agent tool selection (agents are created with a chosen set of tools) and server-level feature enablement, which amount to a coarse tool policy. Missing for 10: documented container/VM sandboxing for code execution, explicit tool permission policies or approval modes, filesystem/network isolation controls, and any independent or hands-on verification.
